name: cxr_quality_tool
description: Deterministic chest X-ray image quality check: dimensions/aspect, exposure (intensity statistics), grayscale check, a projection hint, and a 'looks like a CXR' heuristic. Runs as a pre-detection gate. No model required.

help.summary: Check CXR image quality (exposure, aspect, grayscale, projection hint) before analysis.
notes: Deterministic image checks; no model or weights required.
